title: 7. Nested SELECT
prompt:
A nested SELECT is a query inside another query. The inner query runs first.

houses.name matches students.house.

Return name and house for students whose house is the one headed by Ms Khan. Use a nested SELECT to find that house name.

(Order does not matter.)
solutionQuery: SELECT name, house FROM students WHERE house = (SELECT name FROM houses WHERE head = 'Ms Khan');
